task:
REVISE THE F4 DESIGN DOC FOR FIVE MORE CODEX REVIEW FINDINGS (PR #801, round 6). Target branch codex/run-38015883683-1, expected head 07b621e; fail closed and write nothing if it moved. Only docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-10-v3-finder-f4-archetype-ui-design.md may change. Verify every claim against the code (cite file:line). Extend the existing 'Review dispositions' subsection with a dated round-6 list (finding -> change).

P1-A (doc ~line 298, 'Bound the Any-mode tier count before defaulting to B'): in Any mode a nonzero floor (min_development_score=60 or A/S) is NOT index-bounded for the count: build_count_query (read apps/api/src/ranking/* and local_search.py to cite the exact function and the 10,000-row stop) scans until it finds 10,000 qualifying rows, and system_archetype_summary_weighted is ordered by weighted_potential, not the filtered best_colony_potential, so PostgreSQL may inspect most of ~198.5M rows. FIX the design: in Any mode do NOT apply a tier floor by default (send no min_development_score; keep the existing default behaviour) and make the Minimum tier control selected-archetype-only until a bounded Any-mode access path exists; record that as a new API prerequisite (slice 1d: an index or candidate bound on best_colony_potential for the Any path, or a count cap) and update the dependency map, URL contract (tier param ignored/omitted in Any mode), validation plan and PR plan accordingly.

P1-B (doc ~line 1074, 'Gate the ranking request path, not only the new controls'): with VITE_FINDER_F4_ENABLED=0, a hand-authored ?archetype=... URL must NOT be parsed into ranking state nor trigger the rankings request. FIX: specify that the gate applies to URL hydration (F4 parameters are ignored and stripped), request selection (the rankings branch is unreachable when disabled; the existing search request is preserved unchanged), and all F4 behaviour, not just rendering; add a disabled-build regression test (archetype URL in a disabled build -> identical request to today's and no ranking UI) to F4a's test list.

P2-A (~line 804, 'Put the selected system into the shared URL'): the share URL must serialize system=<id64> on selection (selectResult and map-pick handlers currently write only selectedSystem; AppShell reconstructs selection only from system= — cite ExploreWorkspace.svelte and AppShell.svelte lines); the E2E must load the copied URL in a clean session (clean storage) and assert the marker and Inspect hand-off are restored.

P2-B (~line 634, 'Rehydrate ranking state on history navigation'): specify reactive URL hydration on SvelteKit navigation/popstate so Back/Forward re-parse ranking state (archetype, tier, offset, selection) from the URL and refetch; add Back/Forward tests across picker and pagination changes to the validation plan.

P2-C (~line 703, 'Benchmark the production-shaped join plan'): the slice-1c benchmark receipt must run the real SQL-builder query (cite the builder) against production-shaped scratch relations/views (system_archetype + system_search + summary with the real indexes, seeded at scale on disposable PostgreSQL 18) rather than one flattened scratch table; state that a flattened-table EXPLAIN does not unblock F4b.

Keep the document consistent (dependency map, URL contract, validation plan, PR plan, owner questions). Validation: git diff --name-only origin/main lists only the design doc; Markdown renders. Commit message: 'docs(finder): F4 design — round 6 review (Any-mode tier bound, full feature gate, share URL, history rehydration, real join benchmark)'.
